### [eur_scota_goidel] Nel + Princess Scota (Daughter of Pharaoh!) → Goídel Glas (Gaels)
- **Record Type:** `dynasty_cluster` | **Tradition:** Celtic, Norse, Slavic & European (`europe_norse`, Northern, Eastern & Western Europe)
- **Era / Years:** Lebor Gabála Érenn (Egypt → Spain Bridge) | **Generation Tier:** 10 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 14
- **Role / Title:** Irish-Egyptian Chronicle Bridge (Eponym of Gaels & Scots!)
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Princess Scota of Egypt; Goídel Glas (Gaels)
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_lineage):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> Enoch (Khanokh) & Edni -> Methuselah & Edna -> Lamech (Sethite) & Betenos / Ashmua -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Japheth (Yefet) & Adataneses -> Magog -> Baath (King of Scythia) → Fenius Farsa (Inventor of Letters at Shinar/Babel) -> Fénius Farsaid (Scythian Inventor of Gaelic at Babel) → Nel -> Nel + Princess Scota (Daughter of Pharaoh!) → Goídel Glas (Gaels)
- **Parents (4):** Fénius Farsaid (Scythian Inventor of Gaelic at Babel) → Nel [eur_fenius_farsaid] (direct/parent_of: Fénius Farsaid -> Nel (+ Egyptian Princess Scota) -> Goídel Glas) | Moses (Moshe) [bib_moses] (syncretic/parent_of: Lebor Gabála Érenn says Moses cured young Goídel Glas of a serpent bite in Egypt before the Exodus!) | Ramesses I → Seti I → Ramesses II the Great (+ Nefertari) [eg_ramesses2] (syncretic/parent_of: Irish chronicles name Pharaoh's daughter Scota as mother of the Gaels/Scots) | Niul (+ Scota, Dau. of Pharaoh; Friend of Moses!) → Gaodhal Glas (Gael) → Asruth → Sruth → Heber Scot [irl_niul_gaedhal] (cognate/parent_of: Same Milesian-Scota stem in O'Hart & Lebor Gabála Érenn)
- **Offspring (1):** Breogán (Spain) → Míl Espáine → Éber Finn, Éremón & Amairgin (Milesians) [eur_milesians] (direct/parent_of: Goídel Glas -> ... -> Breogán -> Míl Espáine -> Éber Finn & Éremón)
- **Primary Sources:** Lebor Gabála Érenn; Declaration of Arbroath (1320)
- **Notes:** Nel journeys to Egypt, befriends Moses during the Exodus, and marries Princess Scota (daughter of Pharaoh Cingris!). Their son Goídel Glas gives his name to the Gaels (Goidelic Irish & Scottish), while Scota gives her name to Scotland!

- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Odua; Ile-Ife Cradle; Syncretic Lamurudu/Nimrod lore
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_lineage):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> Enoch (Khanokh) & Edni -> Methuselah & Edna -> Lamech (Sethite) & Betenos / Ashmua -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Yonton / Jonitus (Yônṭôn — 4th Son of Noah) -> Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) -> Olodumare → Obatala & Oduduwa (Progenitor of the Yoruba)

## 3. Egyptian & Canaanite-Phoenician (`levant_egypt` | Nile / Eastern Mediterranean | 237 records)

### [eg_ptah] Ptah (Creator of Memphis — Hikuptah)
- **Record Type:** `person` | **Tradition:** Egyptian & Canaanite-Phoenician (`levant_egypt`, Nile / Eastern Mediterranean)
- **Era / Years:** Memphite Theology (Shabaka Stone) | **Generation Tier:** 1 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 15
- **Role / Title:** Creator Deity of Memphis / Eponym of Egypt & Naphtuhim
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Hephaestus (Manetho); Root of 'Egypt' & Naphtuhim
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_historical):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> Enoch (Khanokh) & Edni -> Methuselah & Edna -> Lamech (Sethite) & Betenos / Ashmua -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Ham (Cham) & Na'eltama'uk -> Cush (Kush) -> Alara of Kush (Founder of Napatan Dynasty) -> Kashta & Queen Pebatjma -> Piye (Piankhi) & Shabaka (25th Dynasty Pharaohs) -> Ptah (Creator of Memphis — Hikuptah)
- **Parents (1):** Piye (Piankhi) & Shabaka (25th Dynasty Pharaohs) [af_piye] (cognate/parent_of: Shabaka preserves the ancient Memphite Theology of Ptah (Shabaka Stone))
- **Offspring (3):** Nun (Primeval Waters) → Atum / Ra (Re) [eg_nun_atum] (expansion/parent_of: Manetho: Ptah (Hephaestus) -> Ra (Helios) -> Shu -> Geb -> Osiris) | Naphtuhim [bib_naphtuhim] (cognate/parent_of: Naphtuhim (Gen 10:13) = Egyptian Na-Ptah ('People of Ptah / Memphis')!) | Manetho's Divine & Shemsu-Hor Horizon (Pre-Menes Era) [eg_manetho_demigods] (expansion/parent_of: Manetho Fr. 1: Ptah -> Re -> Shu -> Geb -> Osiris -> Horus -> Demigods)
- **Primary Sources:** Shabaka Stone; Manetho Aegyptiaca
- **Notes:** Manetho places Ptah (Hephaestus) at the head of Egypt's divine kings! His temple Hikuptah ('House of the Ka of Ptah') gave Greece the word 'Aigyptos' (Egypt), and 'Na-Ptah' ('People of Ptah') is the exact linguistic cognate of Biblical Naphtuhim (Gen 10:13)!

### [gau_poetical_noah_ages] Gautruche's Poetical History Cognates: Golden Age (Saturn/Janus = Noah), Silver Age (Jupiter = Ham), Brazen Age (Nimrod), Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain) & Apollo (= Jubal)
- **Record Type:** `source_meta` | **Tradition:** Greek & Mediterranean (`greek`, Aegean / Anatolia / Italy)

- **Role / Title:** Systematic Identification of Greco-Roman Mythic Figures with Genesis Patriarchs
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Golden Age = Noah; Jupiter = Ham; Vulcan = Tubal-Cain; Apollo = Jubal
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (source_meta):** [Bibliographical / Chronological Source Reference]
- **Parents (0):** None / Root or Preceding Anchor
- **Offspring (0):** None / Terminal Leaf
- **Allies, Rivals & Contemporaries (7):** Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah [bib_noah] (syncretic/contemporary_of: Gautruche Poetical History pp. 8-15: Saturn/Janus (Golden Age) identified with Noah) | Ham (Cham) & Na'eltama'uk [bib_ham] (syncretic/contemporary_of: Gautruche Poetical History pp. 8-15: Jupiter (Silver Age) identified with Ham/Cham) | Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) [bib_nimrod] (syncretic/contemporary_of: Gautruche Poetical History: Brazen Age tyranny traced to Nimrod) | Tubal-cain [bib_tubalcain] (syncretic/contemporary_of: Gautruche Poetical History: Greco-Roman smith Vulcan identified with Tubal-Cain) | Jubal [bib_jubal] (syncretic/contemporary_of: Gautruche Poetical History: Inventor of music Apollo compared with Jubal) | Noah = Janus / Ogyges → Sabatius Saga → Italus (Ancient Kings of Italy / Tuscany) [eur_noah_janus_italy] (cognate/contemporary_of: Same Janus = Noah tradition in Gautruche & Anderson) | Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) [sanch_chrysor_barhebraeus] (cognate/contemporary_of: Parallel Tubal-Cain = Vulcan/Chrysor identification across Gautruche & Sanchuniathon)
- **Primary Sources:** Pierre Gautruche The Poetical History (pp. 8-15)
- **Notes:** Gautruche translates Greco-Roman mythology back into Biblical history: the Golden Age under Saturn/Janus corresponds to Noah (threefold division of the world), the Silver Age to Jupiter (Ham/Cham), the Brazen Age to Nimrod, Vulcan to metal-worker Tubal-Cain, and Apollo to musician Jubal.

- **Parents (1):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) [bib_adam] (expansion/parent_of: Syriac Cave of Treasures: Adam & Eve's twin daughters Lebhûdhâ & Ķelîmath)

- **Notes:** Names every matriarch across 10 antediluvian generations: Cain + twin Lebhûdhâ; Seth + Ķelîmath (Abel's twin); Enos + Ḥannâ; Cainan + Peryath; Mahalalel + Şeḥatpar; Jared + Zebhîdhâ; Enoch + Zadhkîn; Methuselah + Sâkhûth; Lamech + Kîpâr; Noah + Haykêl (daughter of Namûs)! Also names Terah's 2 wives: Yônâ (mother of Abraham) & Salmûth (mother of Sarah).

### [ar_adnan_quraysh] Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Quraysh → Muhammad
- **Record Type:** `dynasty_cluster` | **Tradition:** Arabian (Adnanite & Qahtanite) (`arabian`, Arabian Peninsula)
- **Era / Years:** Classical Arabia → 7th c. CE | **Generation Tier:** 12 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 14
- **Role / Title:** Northern Arabian (Adnanite) & Prophetic Lineage
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Adnanites; Banu Hashim
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_lineage):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> Enoch (Khanokh) & Edni -> Methuselah & Edna -> Eliakim (son of Methuselah) -> Shem (Sem) & Sedeqetelebab -> Melchizedek (King & Priest of Salem) -> Abraham (Abram) -> Ishmael (Isma'il) -> Nebaioth (Nabit) -> Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Quraysh → Muhammad
- **Parents (1):** Nebaioth (Nabit) [ish_nebaioth] (expansion/parent_of: Alternate Arabian tradition via Nabit/Adnan)
- **Offspring (4):** Qusayy → Hashim → Abd al-Muttalib → Prophet Muhammad (570–632 CE) → Fatimah & Ali, Umayyads & Abbasids [ar_hashim_muhammad_caliphs] (direct/parent_of: Adnan -> Fihr (Quraysh) -> Qusayy -> Hashim -> Abd al-Muttalib -> Prophet Muhammad) | Complete 21-Gen Quraysh Lineage (Tabari Vol. 6): Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Mudar → Ilyas → Mudrikah → Khuzaymah → Kinanah → al-Nadr → Malik → Fihr (Quraysh) → Ghalib → Lu'ayy → Ka'b → Murrah → Kilab → Qusayy → 'Abd Manaf → Hashim → 'Abd al-Muttalib → 'Abdallah [tab_adnan_21gen_quraysh] (direct/parent_of: Tabari Vol. 6 pp. 1-44; Lane-Poole; Zambaur: Full 21-generation unbroken pedigree to Prophet Muhammad) | Pre-Islamic Arabian Tribal Tree (Caussin de Perceval Vol. 1): Qahtan (Himyar, Kahlan, Azd, Kindah) & Adnan (Ma'add → Nizar → Mudar & Rabi'a) [cdp_qahtan_adnan_tribes] (cognate/parent_of: Same Adnan -> Ma'add -> Nizar northern Arab tribal genealogy) | Ma'add ibn Adnan (Son of Adnan) [ar4_maadd] (direct/parent_of: Adnan -> son Ma'add)
- **Allies, Rivals & Contemporaries (2):** Kedar (Qaydar) [ish_kedar] (expansion/contemporary_of: Arabian genealogical bridge via Qaydar/Adnan) | Bilali Bounama → Naré Maghann → Sundiata Keita → Mansa Musa [af_sundiata] (syncretic/contemporary_of: Mande griot chronicles link Keita ancestor Bilali Bounama to Ethiopian Bilal (companion of Muhammad))
- **Primary Sources:** Ibn Ishaq Sirah; al-Tabari History; Ibn al-Kalbi
- **Notes:** Classical Arabian genealogies trace the Northern Arabs from Ishmael (via Kedar/Nebaioth) through Adnan -> Ma'add -> Nizar -> Mudar -> Fihr (Quraysh) -> Qusayy -> Abd Manaf -> Hashim -> Abd al-Muttalib -> Abdullah -> Muhammad.

### [mes_uruk_gilgamesh] Gilgamesh (Bilgamesh of Uruk / Erech)
- **Record Type:** `person` | **Tradition:** Mesopotamian (Sumer / Akkad) (`mesopotamian`, Mesopotamia)
- **Era / Years:** Early Dynastic II (c. 2700 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 7 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 8
- **Role / Title:** 5th King of Uruk / Builder of Uruk's Walls / Qumran Giant
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Bilgamesh; Erech (Gen 10:10); Gilgamesh in Qumran 4Q530
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_lineage):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> The Watchers (Semyaza & Azazel) -> Ohya & Hahya (Nephilim Giants) -> Gilgamesh (Bilgamesh of Uruk / Erech)
- **Parents (3):** Lugalbanda & Goddess Ninsun [mes_lugalbanda] (direct/parent_of: Lugalbanda + Ninsun -> Gilgamesh (Epic of Gilgamesh)) | Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) [bib_nimrod] (cognate/parent_of: Gen 10:10 explicitly names Shinar, Babel & Erech (Uruk)) | Ohya & Hahya (Nephilim Giants) [eno_ohya_hahya] (expansion/parent_of: Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530/4Q531) literally names Gilgamesh as a Giant!)
- **Offspring (2):** 10. Ziusudra / Utnapishtim / Atrahasis [mes_ziusudra] (expansion/parent_of: Epic of Gilgamesh XI: Gilgamesh visits Flood survivor Utnapishtim) | Ur-Nungal (son of Gilgamesh) [mes_urnungal] (direct/parent_of: Son (Sumerian King List))
- **Primary Sources:** Sumerian King List; Epic of Gilgamesh; Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530)
- **Notes:** Son of Lugalbanda & Ninsun; visits Flood survivor Utnapishtim. Uruk is explicitly 'Erech' in Gen 10:10 — and 'Gilgamesh' is literally named as a Giant in Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530)!

### [abg_ergenekon_borte] Il Khan → Qiyan & Nukuz (Ergenekon / Irgana-kon) → Bertezena (Börte Čino) → Alan Qo'a → Dutumin → Kaidu → Tumana → Kabul → Bortan → Yesugei
- **Record Type:** `dynasty_cluster` | **Tradition:** Eurasian Steppe / Turkic (`steppe`, Inner Asia / Eurasian Steppe)
- **Era / Years:** Ergenekon Refuge to 12th c. CE (Abulghazi pp. 82-120) | **Generation Tier:** 18 | **Major Landmark:** No | **Steps From Adam:** 13
- **Role / Title:** Restoration from the Ergenekon Valley to the Borjigin Forefathers of Genghis Khan
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Il Khan; Qiyan & Nukuz; Ergenekon; Yesugei
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_lineage):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> Enoch (Khanokh) & Edni -> Methuselah & Edna -> Lamech (Sethite) & Betenos / Ashmua -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Japheth (Yefet) & Adataneses -> Turk (Oljai Khan) → Tatar & Mongol → Oghuz Khagan -> 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz -> Il Khan → Qiyan & Nukuz (Ergenekon / Irgana-kon) → Bertezena (Börte Čino) → Alan Qo'a → Dutumin → Kaidu → Tumana → Kabul → Bortan → Yesugei
- **Parents (1):** 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz [stp_oghuz_six] (expansion/parent_of: Abulghazi pp. 82-120: 6 sons of Oghuz -> Mengli -> Il Khan (Ergenekon refuge) -> Bertezena (Börte Čino) -> Yesugei)
- **Offspring (1):** 20. Temüjin / Činggis Qa'an (Genghis Khan, 1162–1227) & Empress Börte [mng_genghis_khan_borte] (expansion/parent_of: Abulghazi p. 120: Yesugei -> Genghis Khan (Zingis Chan) alongside Secret History of the Mongols)
- **Primary Sources:** Abulghazi Bahadur Khan General History of the Turks pp. 82-120
- **Notes:** After the defeat of Il Khan, survivors Qiyan and Nukuz took refuge in the enclosed valley of Ergenekon (Irgana-kon) for generations until Bertezena (Börte Čino) led the Mongols back out onto the steppe, continuing through Alan Qo'a, Dutumin, Kaidu, Tumana, Kabul, Bortan, and Yesugei.

### [chn_weizi_confucius] Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) → Kong He → Confucius (Kong Qiu)
- **Record Type:** `dynasty_cluster` | **Tradition:** Ancient Chinese (Sinitic) (`chinese`, East Asia / Yellow River)
- **Era / Years:** Zhou / Spring & Autumn (551-479 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 9 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 19
- **Role / Title:** Shang Royal Descendant & China's Great Sage
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Kongzi; Kong Qiu
- **Directed Lineage From Adam (directed_historical):** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Seth (Shet) & Azura -> Enosh & Noam -> Kenan (Cainan) & Mualeleth -> Mahalalel & Dinah -> Jared (Yered) & Baraka -> Enoch (Khanokh) & Edni -> Methuselah & Edna -> Lamech (Sethite) & Betenos / Ashmua -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Fuxi & Nüwa (Three Sovereigns) -> Shaodian & Youqiao (Guoyu) -> Huangdi (Yellow Emperor) & Leizu -> Shaohao (Xuanxiao) → Jiaoji -> Emperor Ku (Di Ku / Gaoxin) -> Xie (son of Di Ku & Jiandi) → Wang Hai -> Tang of Shang (Cheng Tang) → Pan Geng -> King Wu Ding & Warrior Queen Fu Hao -> Di Xin (King Zhou of Shang) — Final Shang King -> Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) → Kong He → Confucius (Kong Qiu)
- **Parents (0):** None / Root or Preceding Anchor
- **Offspring (4):** Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku [jpn_jingu_ojin] (cognate/parent_of: Confucius's Analects transmitted via Baekje to Emperor Ojin's court in Japan (Kojiki/Nihon Shoki)) | Asian Classical Masters: Laozi, Sun Tzu, Mencius, Sima Qian (Shiji), Li Bai; Chanakya, Kalidasa, Adi Shankara & Miyamoto Musashi [fam_asian_sages] (direct/parent_of: Confucius/Mencius/Sima Qian classical Chinese scholarly tradition) | Duke Xiang of Song (Zi Zifu, r. 650 - 637 BCE) [shj13_duke_xiang_song] (direct/parent_of: Shang Royal House of Song) | Master Yan Ying of Qi & Mencius (Meng Ke) [shj13_yan_ying_mencius] (expansion/parent_of: Confucian Transmission (Zisi -> Mencius))
- **Allies, Rivals & Contemporaries (1):** Di Xin (King Zhou of Shang) — Final Shang King [chn_dixin] (direct/contemporary_of: Brother Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) -> ... -> Kong He -> Confucius (Shiji Ch. 47!))
- **Primary Sources:** Shiji Ch. 38 & Ch. 47 (Kongzi Shijia); Analects
- **Notes:** Sima Qian's Shiji Ch. 47 traces Confucius (Kong Qiu) directly back through the Dukes of Song to Weizi Qi (brother of Di Xin) -> Shang Dynasty -> Xie -> Di Ku -> Yellow Emperor!
